name: Monitor AI citation changes for a domain with TriRank and Slack

parameters.content:
## Monitor AI citation changes for a domain with TriRank and Slack

Every Monday this workflow reads a domain's AI-citation reading from TriRank (https://trirankai.com) and posts to Slack **only when the reading changed** since last week. No database, no AI spend — the free TriRank API is read-only and rate-limited per IP (60 reads/day), so a weekly run uses one.

### How it works
1. **Schedule** fires weekly.
2. **Configure domain** holds the one value you edit.
3. **Read TriRank signals** calls `GET /api/signals/<domain>` — which of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity cited the domain, the 0–100 visibility score and when it was measured.
4. **Compare with last run** stores the reading in workflow static data and emits a message only on change (or on the first run, as a baseline).
5. **Post to Slack** delivers it.

### Setup
1. TriRank only reports domains it has measured. Run the free audit for your domain once at https://trirankai.com/audit (it takes a minute and a human captcha — that is what seeds the measurement).
2. Put that domain in **Configure domain**.
3. Add a Slack credential in **Post to Slack** and pick a channel.
4. Activate the workflow. Static data only persists on active (scheduled) runs, not on manual test runs.

Optional: a TriRank API key (Settings → API keys on trirankai.com) raises the daily allowance. Add it as a **Header Auth** credential named `x-api-key` on the HTTP node — never paste it into the node.

### Honesty note
"No citation on record" is not "not cited": the message says which one you are looking at.

## 1 · Schedule & config
Weekly trigger, then the single value you edit: the domain to watch.

## 2 · Read TriRank
One read-only GET. 4xx/5xx do not stop the run; they are reported as a state.

## 3 · Compare with last run
Stores the reading in workflow static data; emits a message only when it changed.

## 4 · Notify
Slack gets the message. Quiet weeks stay quiet.
